title: Concept: Link into a CGI directory
description: A link to a script under a cgi-bin directory in a response gives every reader the same visibility the bank has internally: CGI directories still exist on older deployments, and they run whatever script a request names with the web server's privileges; a link advertises both the directory and the scripts that survived.
applicability: A leftover CGI script is a direct execution surface with the web server's identity.
risk: CGI is a deprecated execution model and should not be advertised from a page.
